messages:
elaine.prod: Heads-up: we're deploying the Hosted Gateway latency budget policy today. This affects hosted endpoints (sync gen, streaming, tool-calling). Please read and adjust client-side targets and SDK hints. Internal doc: https://redwood.internal/hosted/gateway-latency (internal).

elaine.prod: Short summary: set p50/p90 targets per route as listed, avoid aggressive adaptive batching on interactive flows, and implement the fallback routing we describe below.

samir.eng: can we get the numbers inline here?

elaine.prod: p50 = 60ms/token-step for short-chat; p90 = 220ms for streaming first-chunk; p50 = 120ms for long-form routes. Full table and model-family mappings in doc.

maria-ops: rollout schedule: dev & staging flip at 2024-07-12T23:00Z, prod flip at 2024-07-13T03:00Z. We'll watch latency.p90, requests.failed, fallback.count.

kevin-sre: ops notes: fallback will prefer warm quantized-compatible variants for 2m; if capacity/quotas spike, we degrade interactive sessions to sync non-stream endpoints as a last resort.

samir.eng: SDK changes needed? breaking?

elaine.prod: minimal: upcoming SDK release adds optional `latencyBudget` param. Meanwhile use header hint X-RW-Latency-Hint. Example: 

```\n// JS snippet\nconst r = await client.chat.generate({\n  model: 'redwood-chat-light',\n  prompt: '...'\n  , latencyBudget: 'interactive'\n});\n```

kevin-sre: deploy-bot will publish gate events during rollout; watch #eng-monitoring for :rotating_light: alerts.

deploy-bot: [automated] schedule: hosted-gateway-router v2.4 -> v2.5 at 2024-07-12T23:00Z (dev/staging), 2024-07-13T03:00Z (prod). Monitor metrics: latency.p90, requests.failed, fallback.count.

maria-ops: mobile teams: streaming chunk cadence may shift slightly due to batching heuristics. Test against staging after dev flip.

samir.eng: any risk from new kernel selection?

elaine.prod: kernel changes behind a canary flag; default path validated against perf harness. Expect neutral-to-positive for most workloads; fallback ready if regressions show.

kevin-sre: telemetry: start with route-level sampling 0.1 for early adopters to avoid log flood; ramp to 1.0 after 24h if stable.

samir.eng: can you post a short checklist for mobile devs?

elaine.prod: posting a mobile-friendly checklist in #devex in ~30m with SDK snippets, header hints, retry/backoff recs.

maria-ops: post-deploy playbook: if fallback.count > 5% for 15m, rollback router config and open a P1 to eng-runtime.

samir.eng: :thumbsup: thanks for the clarity.

kevin-sre: runbook link added to doc.

elaine.prod: thanks team. Ping me directly if you see anything odd during the flips and post status in #incidents if needed.
